question: Do the reconstructed denominators expose the full Frobenius action on ker(V-1) modulo P~-P, including x-roots whose points are not rational over the sampled extension?

model.kernel: the frozen panel uses the cyclic order-N kernel of V-1 reconstructed in v2
model.x_root_union: D(x(P))=0 is visible over F_(p^d) when lambda^d P=P or lambda^d P=-P because x(P)=x(-P)
model.order_two_indicator: epsilon=1 when N is even and 0 otherwise for this cyclic panel
model.plus_only_wrong_model: floor(g_plus/2), equal to the x-values of actual kernel points rational over F_(p^d)

independent_verifier.method: separate Python extension-field implementation; recompute every denominator root, formal derivative, prediction, and mutation control

positive_checks: the parent result hash and all parent rows match the frozen cells
the denominator coefficients are embedded base-field coefficients and have degree N-1
enumerating every x in F_(p^d) gives exactly the locked root, simple-root, double-root, and weighted-multiplicity counts
the gcd prediction is recomputed rather than copied from locked_predictions
every root has multiplicity one or two as classified by the formal derivative
the numerator is nonzero at every denominator root, including roots not represented by an F_(p^d)-rational curve point
controls: the plus-only model must undercount fp5-a2-b1-d3 and fp7-a1-b1-d2 and must match the other six cells
adding one to the denominator constant must destroy every original denominator root
replacing lambda^d+1 by lambda^d-1 in the union prediction must be detected by the two locked sign-sensitive cells
the retained v1 split-pole failure and v2 result remain byte-unchanged
measurements: g_plus, g_minus, g_intersection and union size
enumerated distinct, simple, double and weighted root counts
roots not visible as rational kernel points
numerator cancellations, mutation survivors, extension-field operations and elapsed nanoseconds

acceptance.primary: all exact producer fields agree with independent replay and every positive check passes in all eight cells
acceptance.controls: both sign-sensitive cells reject the plus-only/wrong-sign model, the other six provide equality controls, and every mutation destroys all original roots
acceptance.failure_policy: retain every row and report any failed prediction or control without changing the frozen formulas, cells, or locked values

claim_boundary: This experiment can validate the cyclic kernel x-orbit model for three toy curves and eight extensions. It does not prove cyclicity, the dual-isogeny identity, degree multiplicativity, deg(V-1)=N in general, a scheme-level morphism statement, an ECDLP algorithm, or any asymptotic speedup.
